ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central lobe regions and 35% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels along the perimeter and peduncle connection.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. The right lobe contains a distinct, dark cross-shaped (+) geometric pigmentation mark in the lower-central quadrant. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the leading and trailing edges, with moderate mottling on the distal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high bounding-box depth relative to the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, low-frequency serrations with three distinct primary peaks. The left lobe trailing edge displays medium-frequency, jagged serrations, partially occluded by water spray at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A strong convex curve follows the leading edge from the peduncle to the distal tips, which terminate in ragged, irregular points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, circular pixel groupings (3-5 distinct spots) are visible within the white field of the left lobe, likely representing attachment points or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark intersecting linear marks forming a '+' shape on the right lobe; several fine, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent cross-shaped mark on the right lobe; both distal lobe tips appear ragged and eroded, indicating significant physical wear or previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The geometric '+' shaped dark pigmentation feature on the right ventral fluke surface is a highly unique identifying marker.
